observations: White multifunction printer with a paper tray at the front.

risks.risk: The device may not power on or may have a faulty print head.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and successfully printing a test page.

risks.risk: The internal drum or toner may be empty or degraded.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner cartridge and a printout showing the current toner level.
risks.if_unproven: as having a missing toner cartridge

risks.risk: The printer may have mechanical faults such as jammed rollers or a broken scanner.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer completing a full print cycle without errors.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner cartridge and a printout showing the current toner level.
Photo of the printer's status screen while powered on.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
